messages:
maria: Quick thread  we need a compact intake probe policy when bench budget is tight. Goal: minimal probes that surface the largest risk vectors (latency regressions, tokenizer/serialization drift, kv-warmup failures).

sam: Agree. Start with a FAST smoke run everywhere: p95 latency, kv-cache sanity, tokenizer-diff. Deterministic, fast, and must be reproducible. :thumbsup:

jon: Add a tiny golden-check of ~20 fixed prompts in FAST to catch decode/serialization issues. Cheap but often catches the weird ones.

maria: Proposal: three tiers. FAST (<=45s) runs on every submit. MID (5-12m) runs on tokenizer/arch/major config changes or sampled. DEEP (>30m) nightly or manual for full eval. Thoughts?

eva: Tiers look good. FAST should include a cold-start snapshot (first 10 tokens p50/p95) since warmup behavior hides regressions.

sam: FAST invariants: fixed seed, no sampling, short seq len (<=64), single-worker runner to reduce noise.

jon: For MID, 200 stratified golden inputs across seqlen and content types (code/dialogue/prose) gives good quality signal without full cost.

maria: Intake selection rules draft: 
```
if change.tokenizer or arch_changed:
  run MID
elif change.quantization or compile_flags:
  run FAST + 10% sampled MID
else:
  run FAST
```
If FAST fails -> promote to MID and block onboarding until triage. Does that make sense?

sam: Yes. Make promotions explicit and surface artifacts in Console. No silent pass.

jon: Add fallback routing: if MID OOMs on target pool, rerun MID on a smaller-batch or quantized variant and mark "needs-review".

maria: Observability: standardize metrics so Console can compare models: latency_p95_ms, coldstart_p95_ms, kv_miss_rate, tokenizer_diff_count, golden_mismatch_count.

eva: Also include provenance fields with every run: probe_version, code_sha, runner_image, hardware_profile, golden_set_id. Helps debug infra vs model issues.

sam: FAST runner sketch: 
```
run_probe --kind fast --seq-len 32 --seed 42 --prompts fast_prompts.json --out metrics.json
```
Expect exit 0 and metrics.json with latency_p95_ms, kv_miss_rate, tokenizer_diff_count. Non-zero -> upload logs + artifacts.

maria: We need a fast_prompts.json (≈40 prompts) covering short convo, code snippet, whitespace/tokenization edges, unicode. Who can author?

jon: I will assemble and push a 40-prompt set to ml-goldsets/fast_smoke/ tomorrow, including expected outputs for the golden checks.

probe-bot: probe-bot: FAST probe run report: latency_p95_ms=36, coldstart_p95_ms=68, kv_miss_rate=0.018, tokenizer_diff_count=0, golden_mismatch_count=0. :white_check_mark:

maria: Nice. Next steps: I'll write a short RFC to formalize tiers, intake selection algorithm, metric schema, artifact URIs, and a FAST-failure runbook (promote->block->triage). Will circulate by EOD. tagging @sam @jon @eva for review. :eyes:
